description: A system dynamics model using the SIR model to simulate the spread of a virus in a fixed population.

behaviors.name: contract_virus
behaviors.description: A susceptible person contracts the virus if exposed to an infected person.
behaviors.algorithm: If a susceptible person comes into contact with an infected person, they may become infected based on the infection rate.

behaviors.name: recover
behaviors.description: An infected person recovers after a certain duration.
behaviors.algorithm: An infected person's status changes to recovered based on the recovery rate and infection duration.

interactions.name: virus_transmission
interactions.description: Transmission of the virus from an infected person to a susceptible person.
interactions.effect: Changes a susceptible person's status to infected if they are in contact with an infected person.

algorithms.SIR_dynamics: Implements the traditional SIR model equations to update the counts of susceptible, infected, and recovered individuals.

files.name: main.py
files.description: Main script to run the simulation.

files.name: sir_model.py
files.description: Contains the implementation of the SIR model dynamics.

files.name: visualization.py
files.description: Handles the visualization of the simulation results.
